label: Blind sample burn 007: MTBS Kennedy Peak fire, VA, 2019-11-14

verdict.headline: Real change
verdict.statement: Burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.08 relative to the control trajectory in the 6 months after 14 Nov 2019 (90% interval −0.11 to −0.05). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 1 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.03). Counted by gap size instead, 1 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.03).

evidence.sentence: Optical shows the change (burn ratio (NBR) fell by 0.08); radar is inconclusive (radar backscatter (VH) −0.0 dB, interval −0.1 to 0.1).
